speaker: Riverblade Squad Mercenary
content: ...Understood.

speaker: Riverblade Squad Mercenary
content: This is the op team. Advanced-Ops Adviser has retrieved the 'Sand Soldier' survivor along with target material.

speaker: Riverblade Squad Mercenary
content: Acknowledged.

content: Adviser, recon team has ensured the safety of our route.

content: Alright, then. Let's go.

content: Uh, Mr. Elliot, please kindly give that case to us.

content: The boy tightly clutches the case in his hands.

speaker: Riverblade Squad Mercenary
content: Adviser?

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Leave him be.

raw: [name="Riverblade Squad Mercenary"]  Pardon me, but we should confirm whether our objective materials are intact. And ensure 'no matter the circumstances,' they're safe under our grasp.
speaker: Riverblade Squad Mercenary
content: Pardon me, but we should confirm whether our objective materials are intact. And ensure 'no matter the circumstances,' they're safe under our grasp.

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: You think he'll run?

raw: [name="Riverblade Squad Mercenary"]  No, of course... alright... understood.
speaker: Riverblade Squad Mercenary
content: No, of course... alright... understood.

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Yes.

raw: [name="Riverblade Squad Mercenary A"]  Uh, why did we stop?
speaker: Riverblade Squad Mercenary A
content: Uh, why did we stop?

raw: [name="Riverblade Squad Mercenary B"]  Seems we broke down.
speaker: Riverblade Squad Mercenary B
content: Seems we broke down.

raw: [name="Riverblade Squad Mercenary"]  What's wrong? Caster, come take a look.
speaker: Riverblade Squad Mercenary
content: What's wrong? Caster, come take a look.

raw: [name="Riverblade Squad Mercenary"]  Couldn't be out of fuel, right... did nobody inspect before we left base? Who was in charge?
speaker: Riverblade Squad Mercenary
content: Couldn't be out of fuel, right... did nobody inspect before we left base? Who was in charge?

raw: [name="Riverblade Squad Mercenary"]  J5 from the Stouthammer Squad was on vehicle inspection, but they're all on the recon team. What should we do? Get in touch with them?
speaker: Riverblade Squad Mercenary
content: J5 from the Stouthammer Squad was on vehicle inspection, but they're all on the recon team. What should we do? Get in touch with them?

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Elliot.

speaker: Elliot
content: Huh?

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  Keep that case safe, and lower your head.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Keep that case safe, and lower your head.

speaker: Elliot
content: ...What?

speaker: Riverblade Squad Mercenary
content: What just exploded—woah!

raw: [name="Riverblade Squad Mercenary"]  Recon team?! Hey, can you hear us? Tell your Casters to stop! It's us, wait, it's us!
speaker: Riverblade Squad Mercenary
content: Recon team?! Hey, can you hear us? Tell your Casters to stop! It's us, wait, it's us!

content: Mon3tr.

speaker: Elliot
content: Th—That thing in your hand—

content: (With vigor, it rouses itself.)

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: No, don't be rash.

content: Protect this child.

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.5, xstrength=15, ystrength=15, vibrato=20, randomness=70, fadeout=true, block=false)]

content: Stay alert, Mon3tr.

content: (Dissatisfied)

[name="Riverblade Squad Mercenary"]  Dammit! They split as cover to set up the whole goddamn circus...!!
speaker: Riverblade Squad Mercenary
content: Dammit! They split as cover to set up the whole goddamn circus...!!

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.1, xstrength=10, ystrength=12, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=true)]
[name="Riverblade Squad Mercenary"]  Attention, Riverblade Squad, all members of Riverblade Squad!
speaker: Riverblade Squad Mercenary
content: Attention, Riverblade Squad, all members of Riverblade Squad!

raw: [name="Riverblade Squad Mercenary"]  The recon team has overtly attacked us, scratching every—clause of the contract! Caster division, ready up! Snipers, confirm bearings, and prepare to attack!
speaker: Riverblade Squad Mercenary
content: The recon team has overtly attacked us, scratching every—clause of the contract! Caster division, ready up! Snipers, confirm bearings, and prepare to attack!

[CameraShake(duration=1, xstrength=8, ystrength=6, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[name="Riverblade Squad Mercenary"]  You all copy! The Stouthammer Squad has turned traitor! Fight back, open fire!!
speaker: Riverblade Squad Mercenary
content: You all copy! The Stouthammer Squad has turned traitor! Fight back, open fire!!

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.5, xstrength=15, ystrength=15, vibrato=20, randomness=70, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[name="Kal'tsit"]  In the barrens, escaping an armed motorcade on foot isn't much of a sagacious choice.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: In the barrens, escaping an armed motorcade on foot isn't much of a sagacious choice.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  Stay here. This is the safest option.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Stay here. This is the safest option.

speaker: Elliot
content: Ugh...

speaker: Elliot
content: Did you plan this, too?

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  No. War can bring great profit to Columbia, but nobody wants that profit in anyone else's pocket. Dividing up interests isn't just about size, and satisfying everyone is extremely difficult.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: No. War can bring great profit to Columbia, but nobody wants that profit in anyone else's pocket. Dividing up interests isn't just about size, and satisfying everyone is extremely difficult.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  As their advanced operations adviser, I've given sufficient counsel.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: As their advanced operations adviser, I've given sufficient counsel.

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Including all 'betrayal' possibility.

raw: [name="Elliot"]  Right now, there's a war going on outside...
speaker: Elliot
content: Right now, there's a war going on outside...

raw: [name="Elliot"]  And you're just going to sit in here, unconcerned?
speaker: Elliot
content: And you're just going to sit in here, unconcerned?

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  I have to remind you, Elliot, you also sit here, receiving my protection at that.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: I have to remind you, Elliot, you also sit here, receiving my protection at that.

raw: [name="Elliot"]  No... it's this box. They don't have the guts to attack us. I'm the one who's your protection, 'Adviser.'
speaker: Elliot
content: No... it's this box. They don't have the guts to attack us. I'm the one who's your protection, 'Adviser.'

speaker: Mon3tr
content: (Discontentedly, it gazes afar.)

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  I don't intend to retort. They absolutely won't dare destroy an Arts prototype that could convert half of Sargon's rainforests into barrens.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: I don't intend to retort. They absolutely won't dare destroy an Arts prototype that could convert half of Sargon's rainforests into barrens.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  Despite its disguise as... an engine on an all-new power source.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Despite its disguise as... an engine on an all-new power source.

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.3, xstrength=30, ystrength=30, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[name="Elliot"]  What—What are you going on about...
speaker: Elliot
content: What—What are you going on about...

raw: [name="Riverblade Squad Mercenary"]  Adviser! We can't hold out for much longer! We need to pull back immediately, and change course!
speaker: Riverblade Squad Mercenary
content: Adviser! We can't hold out for much longer! We need to pull back immediately, and change course!

raw: [name="Riverblade Squad Mercenary"]  Please, bring the survivor with us! We'll ensure your safety!
speaker: Riverblade Squad Mercenary
content: Please, bring the survivor with us! We'll ensure your safety!

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Understood.

raw: [name="Riverblade Squad Mercenary Captain"]  How many withdrew?
speaker: Riverblade Squad Mercenary Captain
content: How many withdrew?

raw: [name="Riverblade Squad Mercenary"]  Less than twenty. Wretched losses.
speaker: Riverblade Squad Mercenary
content: Less than twenty. Wretched losses.

raw: [name="Riverblade Squad Mercenary"]  Let me say again, Captain, scores of our brothers just died.
speaker: Riverblade Squad Mercenary
content: Let me say again, Captain, scores of our brothers just died.

raw: [name="Riverblade Squad Mercenary"]  Thanks to them pulling a heel turn out of their assholes in the middle of an operation! The company's gonna send people to wipe every last one of 'em off the goddamn map!!
speaker: Riverblade Squad Mercenary
content: Thanks to them pulling a heel turn out of their assholes in the middle of an operation! The company's gonna send people to wipe every last one of 'em off the goddamn map!!

raw: [name="Riverblade Squad Mercenary Captain"]  I... don't know about that. If the Stouthammers had this planned in advance, I'm worried the company hasn't got the reach into Sargon...
speaker: Riverblade Squad Mercenary Captain
content: I... don't know about that. If the Stouthammers had this planned in advance, I'm worried the company hasn't got the reach into Sargon...

raw: [name="Riverblade Squad Mercenary Captain"]  Maybe they made a deal with some lord ameer. Or maybe, they just never...
speaker: Riverblade Squad Mercenary Captain
content: Maybe they made a deal with some lord ameer. Or maybe, they just never...

raw: [name="Riverblade Squad Mercenary Captain"]  Ugh... the adviser and the kid?
speaker: Riverblade Squad Mercenary Captain
content: Ugh... the adviser and the kid?

speaker: Riverblade Squad Mercenary
content: Right over there.

raw: [name="Riverblade Squad Mercenary Captain"]  Let me... let me talk with them alone.
speaker: Riverblade Squad Mercenary Captain
content: Let me... let me talk with them alone.

speaker: Riverblade Squad Mercenary Captain
content: Adviser.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  Before we entered Sargon, I gave you the heads-up.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Before we entered Sargon, I gave you the heads-up.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  The military needed to light a fire in Sargon, and then wait for war to bring riches their way.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: The military needed to light a fire in Sargon, and then wait for war to bring riches their way.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  Factories, mines, the arms trade—every second of its existence, Columbia has been gnawing away at this ancient country, strengthening itself.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Factories, mines, the arms trade—every second of its existence, Columbia has been gnawing away at this ancient country, strengthening itself.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  So its military pulled a move, brought about the birth of the 'Sand Soldiers,' had them bring scientific researchers into Sargon... to carry out some 'tech support.'
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: So its military pulled a move, brought about the birth of the 'Sand Soldiers,' had them bring scientific researchers into Sargon... to carry out some 'tech support.'

raw: [name="Riverblade Squad Mercenary Captain"]  —But the Bureau doesn't take things that way at all.
speaker: Riverblade Squad Mercenary Captain
content: —But the Bureau doesn't take things that way at all.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  To be precise, it's the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Arts Units and Originium and its background desires that don't take things that way.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: To be precise, it's the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Arts Units and Originium and its background desires that don't take things that way.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  Perhaps Sargon is a backwards, rotting country to some people's eyes, but its ancient wealth and power still suffices to command servitude of all the dust in its sky, to become the desert under the Empire's gaze.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Perhaps Sargon is a backwards, rotting country to some people's eyes, but its ancient wealth and power still suffices to command servitude of all the dust in its sky, to become the desert under the Empire's gaze.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  I have to say, the Bureau's viewpoint is correct.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: I have to say, the Bureau's viewpoint is correct.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  One portion of Columbia's people has grown narrow-minded with its ballooning riches and power. They mistakenly think they can cause wanton strife in Sargon without paying a price.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: One portion of Columbia's people has grown narrow-minded with its ballooning riches and power. They mistakenly think they can cause wanton strife in Sargon without paying a price.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  Any one Padishah's maneuvering is enough to influence those Columbian entrepreneurs' stock prices, yet they turn a blind eye to Sargon's vast might.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Any one Padishah's maneuvering is enough to influence those Columbian entrepreneurs' stock prices, yet they turn a blind eye to Sargon's vast might.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  The policymakers are free to be ignorant, and failure in judgment won't harm their core interests, but you yourselves need to know just what it is you're doing.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: The policymakers are free to be ignorant, and failure in judgment won't harm their core interests, but you yourselves need to know just what it is you're doing.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  At least, you should know, this and your life or death are symbiotic.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: At least, you should know, this and your life or death are symbiotic.

raw: [name="Riverblade Squad Mercenary Captain"]  The Padishahs are the Sargon Empire's chief governors at the core, there to control their lords ameer. Would they... have anything to do with the company?
speaker: Riverblade Squad Mercenary Captain
content: The Padishahs are the Sargon Empire's chief governors at the core, there to control their lords ameer. Would they... have anything to do with the company?

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  You know what it is the company wants, correct?
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: You know what it is the company wants, correct?

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  Certain high-ranking members of the military have seized some of Blaine Formative Technologies' principal shareholders, exporting these things to Sargon under unofficial cover in order to fulfill a deal with a lord ameer.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Certain high-ranking members of the military have seized some of Blaine Formative Technologies' principal shareholders, exporting these things to Sargon under unofficial cover in order to fulfill a deal with a lord ameer.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  And what they truly desire is to employ these simple, crude methods to set off a power struggle within Ibut. Because that will turn profit.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: And what they truly desire is to employ these simple, crude methods to set off a power struggle within Ibut. Because that will turn profit.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  But the Bureau believes that if the war spreads to the heart of the empire, every 'moneymaking' design will become fly ash.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: But the Bureau believes that if the war spreads to the heart of the empire, every 'moneymaking' design will become fly ash.

raw: [name="Riverblade Squad Mercenary Captain"]  So, the Bureau wants us to retrieve the target, so as to stop the military brass from going a step too far. That I get, but—
speaker: Riverblade Squad Mercenary Captain
content: So, the Bureau wants us to retrieve the target, so as to stop the military brass from going a step too far. That I get, but—

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  But the military's not stupid. Its spies within the company—perhaps you've already guessed who—have bribed the Stouthammer Squad to ensure the plans will remain in Sargon, and then a certain lord ameer can set off war.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: But the military's not stupid. Its spies within the company—perhaps you've already guessed who—have bribed the Stouthammer Squad to ensure the plans will remain in Sargon, and then a certain lord ameer can set off war.

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.3, xstrength=30, ystrength=30, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[name="Riverblade Squad Mercenary Captain"]  They had the balls?!
speaker: Riverblade Squad Mercenary Captain
content: They had the balls?!

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  Aside from the operation advisers that aren't me, all silently acknowledge this string of activity inside the company.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Aside from the operation advisers that aren't me, all silently acknowledge this string of activity inside the company.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  The Chief of Business has no plans to stand on any side, allowing both parties to hold each other back. It might even bring in bonus grey income, after all.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: The Chief of Business has no plans to stand on any side, allowing both parties to hold each other back. It might even bring in bonus grey income, after all.

raw: [name="Riverblade Squad Mercenary Captain"]  None of this is any kid's business.
speaker: Riverblade Squad Mercenary Captain
content: None of this is any kid's business.

speaker: Elliot
content: I—

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  Elliot Glover. Only 13 when he skipped a few grades and graduated, soon entering an academy for sciences and taking up studies in Originium technology.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Elliot Glover. Only 13 when he skipped a few grades and graduated, soon entering an academy for sciences and taking up studies in Originium technology.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  Three years after, this young genius was picked out by Professor Thorne, to become in all respects his personal assistant.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Three years after, this young genius was picked out by Professor Thorne, to become in all respects his personal assistant.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  Elliot is a member of the 'Sand Soldiers.' A research team crowned as soldiers who had no idea at all what awaited them in Sargon.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Elliot is a member of the 'Sand Soldiers.' A research team crowned as soldiers who had no idea at all what awaited them in Sargon.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  They died tragically in the sandstorm without a single clue about anything, and none of us can deprive their last survivor of learning the complete picture.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: They died tragically in the sandstorm without a single clue about anything, and none of us can deprive their last survivor of learning the complete picture.

raw: [name="Riverblade Squad Mercenary Captain"]  Fine, I get it. No skin off my nose.
speaker: Riverblade Squad Mercenary Captain
content: Fine, I get it. No skin off my nose.

raw: [name="Riverblade Squad Mercenary Captain"]  Now where were we? Oh, yeah, Bureau and the military pressured the company, and then in Sargon, all the lords ameer clashed...
speaker: Riverblade Squad Mercenary Captain
content: Now where were we? Oh, yeah, Bureau and the military pressured the company, and then in Sargon, all the lords ameer clashed...

raw: [name="Riverblade Squad Mercenary Captain"]  Heheh. We were betrayed from the very beginning. And we jumped into this war knowing scratch all...
speaker: Riverblade Squad Mercenary Captain
content: Heheh. We were betrayed from the very beginning. And we jumped into this war knowing scratch all...

raw: [name="Riverblade Squad Mercenary Captain"]  Where'd they get the balls to do this shit... Now they've thrown us into the desert like garbage, who can still guarantee things'll go how they want...?
speaker: Riverblade Squad Mercenary Captain
content: Where'd they get the balls to do this shit... Now they've thrown us into the desert like garbage, who can still guarantee things'll go how they want...?

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  The company never cared about what ultimately ended up in whose hands. Regardless of which of you survived to complete the mission, they'd still pocket a reward.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: The company never cared about what ultimately ended up in whose hands. Regardless of which of you survived to complete the mission, they'd still pocket a reward.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  To be precise, even if you all died right here, it wouldn't affect a single coin that falls into their pockets.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: To be precise, even if you all died right here, it wouldn't affect a single coin that falls into their pockets.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  Because the ever-eyeing lords ameer and the Padishahs would've helped you settle and follow up on things otherwise, it's only natural they brought in the chaos.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Because the ever-eyeing lords ameer and the Padishahs would've helped you settle and follow up on things otherwise, it's only natural they brought in the chaos.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  The moment you were first drawn into Sargon by that enormous reward, you were already cornered.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: The moment you were first drawn into Sargon by that enormous reward, you were already cornered.

speaker: Riverblade Squad Mercenary Captain
content: Sorry, Adviser.

raw: [name="Riverblade Squad Mercenary Captain"]  You warned us out of the kindness of your heart, and you gave our op everything you had too. I respect you a hell of a lot more than I do those cigar munchers, all making up absolute shit at their meeting tables.
speaker: Riverblade Squad Mercenary Captain
content: You warned us out of the kindness of your heart, and you gave our op everything you had too. I respect you a hell of a lot more than I do those cigar munchers, all making up absolute shit at their meeting tables.

raw: [name="Riverblade Squad Mercenary Captain"]  But maybe... we still have one other option. Right now, pull out your arms, Adviser. I hope this decisive battle can preserve some dignity.
speaker: Riverblade Squad Mercenary Captain
content: But maybe... we still have one other option. Right now, pull out your arms, Adviser. I hope this decisive battle can preserve some dignity.

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.5, xstrength=15, ystrength=15, vibrato=20, randomness=70, fadeout=true, block=false)]

speaker: Elliot
content: You're going to kill her...!

raw: [name="Riverblade Squad Mercenary Captain"]  Why not? That's what our original job really was, after all.
speaker: Riverblade Squad Mercenary Captain
content: Why not? That's what our original job really was, after all.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  Don't lose your head, mercenary. I know you've received secret orders from the Chief of Business, but I also trust you understand that right now, following things to the letter will only cut off your own way out.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Don't lose your head, mercenary. I know you've received secret orders from the Chief of Business, but I also trust you understand that right now, following things to the letter will only cut off your own way out.

raw: [name="Riverblade Squad Mercenary Captain"]  Yeah, you've always given me an omniscient kind of impression...
speaker: Riverblade Squad Mercenary Captain
content: Yeah, you've always given me an omniscient kind of impression...

raw: [name="Riverblade Squad Mercenary Captain"]  The company sold us out, the Chief of Business sacked us like pawns, the lords ameer, the Padishahs and the Columbian military are all itching to kill us and snatch the goods—
speaker: Riverblade Squad Mercenary Captain
content: The company sold us out, the Chief of Business sacked us like pawns, the lords ameer, the Padishahs and the Columbian military are all itching to kill us and snatch the goods—

raw: [name="Riverblade Squad Mercenary Captain"]  —but we're mercs, and that's just morning coffee to us. As long as I can still make bank, I have no shits to give.
speaker: Riverblade Squad Mercenary Captain
content: —but we're mercs, and that's just morning coffee to us. As long as I can still make bank, I have no shits to give.

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: What a pity.

raw: [name="Riverblade Squad Mercenary Captain"]  I'm just the smallest fry in this whole whirlwind of crisis, but whether it's in the Bureau's interest or the military's—whatever. All that shit makes me dizzy—
speaker: Riverblade Squad Mercenary Captain
content: I'm just the smallest fry in this whole whirlwind of crisis, but whether it's in the Bureau's interest or the military's—whatever. All that shit makes me dizzy—

raw: [name="Riverblade Squad Mercenary Captain"]  Even the company thinks you shouldn't hang around here any longer, Adviser.
speaker: Riverblade Squad Mercenary Captain
content: Even the company thinks you shouldn't hang around here any longer, Adviser.

raw: [name="Riverblade Squad Mercenary Captain"]  This is a good chance. A good chance to make a senior adviser in Sargon disappear. Some folks paid me a lot of money—heh, and I couldn't say if they were the same who bribed the Stouthammers.
speaker: Riverblade Squad Mercenary Captain
content: This is a good chance. A good chance to make a senior adviser in Sargon disappear. Some folks paid me a lot of money—heh, and I couldn't say if they were the same who bribed the Stouthammers.

raw: [name="Riverblade Squad Mercenary Captain"]  But none of that matters. I just wanna ask you one last thing... You... You've done so much. What was it all for, in the end?
speaker: Riverblade Squad Mercenary Captain
content: But none of that matters. I just wanna ask you one last thing... You... You've done so much. What was it all for, in the end?

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  Columbia, Sargon, and perhaps Victoria as well. Uncountable powers all wrapped up in this. And though their lack of foresight led us here, all their innumerable machinations point towards one endgame.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Columbia, Sargon, and perhaps Victoria as well. Uncountable powers all wrapped up in this. And though their lack of foresight led us here, all their innumerable machinations point towards one endgame.

speaker: Riverblade Squad Mercenary Captain
content: —War.

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: And war will bring ruin.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  I simply try to stop this all from coming, despite how weak my influence is.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: I simply try to stop this all from coming, despite how weak my influence is.

raw: [name="Riverblade Squad Mercenary Captain"]  I... I don't know whether I oughta believe you... Maybe as long as I complete the Chief's orders and kill you, the company'll let us back in...
speaker: Riverblade Squad Mercenary Captain
content: I... I don't know whether I oughta believe you... Maybe as long as I complete the Chief's orders and kill you, the company'll let us back in...

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  Who would trust sixteen mercenaries forced to hole up in a cave, a scientist's boy assistant and a mercenary company's operations adviser? Who would willingly sit down with them to discuss where millions of lives are headed?
